summary: Per-frame AI ability/driver tick: selects the AI engagement mode from the ring-buffer input, scales AI difficulty for the session, applies a per-frame +/-0.01 adjustment and a probability-based override to the driver ability value (this+0x453C), recomputes the steering target from vehicle setup bounds, and drives pit-stop decision logic (pit exit force, tire-compound pit duration, post-pit state reset, fuel-weight pit exit) gated by session type and race phase.

operations.description: Guard: if FinishState (this+0x4064) equals 1, disable the active flag (this+0x4544) and scale difficulty to 0.75x (this+0x457C via AIDifficultyScalar).

RingBufferAccessWithWrap on the ring-buffer input index (this+0x4044) selects the engagement mode: pit-lane mode (value 2) disables the active flag (this+0x4544) and sets difficulty to AIDifficultyScalar()*0.75 (this+0x457C); mode 0/1 keeps full AIDifficultyScalar().

Per-frame ability drift: when the frame latch (this+0x4508) is clear, adjust driverAbility (this+0x453C) by -0.01 clamped to this+0x44F4; otherwise adjust by +0.01 clamped to the upper bound derived from this+0x44D8. Runs only for session type 7 (dword_7C56A4).

Probability-based override of driverAbility (this+0x453C): compare (this+0x44D4 - this+0x450C*0.5)*100 against RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator()%100, then either raise ability toward the upper bound (this+0x44D8 + this+0x44F4) or lower it to half this+0x44F4.
Clear the per-frame ability latches (this+0x4508 and this+0x450C) after the drift/override adjustment.

Car-condition gate (this+0x3D6C): if not equal to 2 and speed threshold (this+0x3984) is valid while this+0x4000 is non-positive, evaluate pit-exit conditions -- ForcePitExit fires when this car's setup pointer (this+0x0) shows worn/unusable components (obj+0xCD4) or a pit-lap trigger (byte this+0x39FA with lap counter this+0x403C vs TotalRaceLaps). In condition 1 also set driverAbility (this+0x453C) to 0.85*this+0x44F4.

Steering-target recompute, gated on session type / final lap / finish state: skip when session type is not 7, lap (this+0x403C) is not the last (dword_8ACF8C-1), finish value (this+0x4040) is not 2 or -1, or speed (this+0x4440) is below 5. Otherwise compute the field at this+0x4534 = session time + 120 and the signed setup-limit steering target from the vehicle-setup pointer (this+0x4354) bounds +0x34/+0x38 vs this+0x4428, stored to this+0x4420; clear the pit byte (this+0x4579).
ConditionalGate runs for session type 7; when this+0x4000 is positive and the reason slot (this+0x4068) is clear, set ReasonCode to 6.

When speed (this+0x4440) is below 1.0, enter the pit-stop decision path: session type 7 clears the pit-lane byte (this+0x45F4) and returns; otherwise run PitStopDecisionTireCompound using the tire-compound slot (this+0x45E0).

Select pit-stop duration from the tire-compound delay table (indexed by this+0x45E0, table at this+4453): compare elapsed time (this+0x3988) against the per-compound duration, taking 1.0 as the minimum floor.

Post-pit reset sequence: SpeedValueSetterWithGlobalMirror(1.0 or the compound duration), PostPitCleanup, disable the active flag (this+0x4544), ParameterValueSetter(18), set this+0x4550 to 1, set the pit-exit byte (this+0x4548), clear steering/offset fields (this+0x443C, this+0x34F8, this+0x3500, this+0x34FC, this+0x43F8), AIClearStateFlags, set the steering mode (this+0x4510 = 4/5), clear this+0x4524 / this+0x4438 / this+0x4434 / this+0x454C / this+0x4424, re-raise this+0x4550, and call sub_426430; set this+0x4534 = session time + 180.

Fuel-weight pit exit: for session type 7, when FuelMultiplierValue is in the 1..2 range and both this car and the other vehicle (this+0x45F8) pass FuelWeightLimitCheck, force a pit exit via ForcePitExit.
Evaluate pit entry via RacePhasePitEntryTrigger(this) and write the invalidation sentinel NAN to this+0x44B0 at end of tick; the return value is the pit-entry trigger result.

clean_pseudocode: if sessionType == 7: ability += (frameLatch? +0.01 : -0.01) clamped to [0x44F4, 0x44D8]; RNG probability override; clear latches
if carConditions == 1 and speed ok: maybe ForcePitExit; ability = 0.85 * lowerClamp
if not final-lap gate: steeringTarget = sign(setupLimit) using +0x34/+0x38; clear pit byte 0x4579
if speed < 1.0: pit-stop decision (tire compound) -> post-pit reset sequence
